task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First stop, open the chest drawer within the bedroom. After that, retrieve the old key from the chest drawer. And then, check that the wooden door is unlocked with the old key. Having unlocked the wooden door, open the wooden door in the bedroom. After pulling open the wooden door, attempt to venture east. And then, open the refrigerator in the kitchen. And then, take the half of a bag of chips from the refrigerator inside the kitchen. And then, put the half of a bag of chips on the stove in the kitchen. Alright, thanks!
